newsitem.title: USA: Micronics loss widens in revision.
newsitem.headline: Micronics loss widens in revision.

text.p: Micronics Computers Inc said Monday that as a result of its annual audit, it had revised its financial statements for the year ended September 30, 1996, to reflect a net loss of $13.3 million, or $0.96 per share.
Micronics previously reported a net loss of $12.8 million, or $0.92 per share, for the year, compared with a fiscal 1995 net loss of $12.8 million, or $0.95 per share.

Micronics said it recroded non-cash charges of $523,000 to reflect the writeoff of certain European assets, the addition of reserves against accounts receivable and inventory, and additional accruals for expected expenses.
